findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_place" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.zindies.co" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_creator, get_creation, get_place, get_event, list_events, list_events_by_place, list_events_by_creator, find_places_nearby, list_apps, list_followable_zones, toggle_favorite · Private data: get_creator, get_creation, get_place, get_event, list_events, list_events_by_place, list_events_by_creator, find_places_nearby, list_apps, list_followable_zones, toggle_favorite, rsvp_event · Public sink: get_creation · Destructive: list_apps, toggle_favorite.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_creator, get_creation, get_place, get_event, list_events, list_events_by_place, list_events_by_creator, find_places_nearby, list_apps, list_followable_zones, toggle_favorite · Private data: get_creator, get_creation, get_place, get_event, list_events, list_events_by_place, list_events_by_creator, find_places_nearby, list_apps, list_followable_zones, toggle_favorite, rsvp_event · Public sink: get_creation · Destructive: list_apps, toggle_favorite

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
